# NovaPanel v1.6.143

- Fleet configuration orchestration now gives copied inbound nodes a target-host-qualified name, while keeping the source panel's original name. Existing copied inbounds are renamed in place on first re-apply, and repeat previews/deployments remain idempotent.
- Updated route and DNS inbound selectors, client subscription names, inbound traffic statistics, and browsing-history inbound labels when migrating an existing target inbound.
- Clarified the automatic target-host naming behavior in the inbound picker across all supported UI languages.
- Restored aggregate Clash subscriptions to their previous behavior; aggregate node naming and deduplication are unchanged by this release.
